title: The Boom Before the Bust
coreMove: Read a boom for the hidden habits it is teaching before success makes them untouchable.
sourcePressure: Warns that successful periods can normalize habits and structures that later become failure mechanisms; strong results can postpone diagnosis.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating the boom as simple greed, luck, or macroeconomic history instead of cultural training during success.

counterintuition: numbers versus people as a flat binary
